text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes into production. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project. As a result, the whole team becomes stronger. In addition, regular code reviews improve team quality because everyone follows the same standards and good practices. In short, code reviews help teams write better code, learn together, and build a stronger product.
